title: incident-bot: enrich escalation context with SLO / runbook snapshots and recent oncall notes
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot to include SLO snapshots, runbook excerpt links, and latest on-call notes in escalation messages (non-breaking).
body:
Motivation: On-call escalations often lack immediate context - engineers need quick access to the affected SLO, the relevant runbook steps, and any recent on-call notes so they can triage faster. This PR augments incident-bot escalations with a compact context block: a snapshot of the nearest SLO(s), a short excerpt plus link to the canonical runbook, and the last 24h of on-call sticky notes.

What this PR does:
- Adds an 'escalation_context' enrichment path in incident-bot (configurable per-service).
- Fetches the most relevant SLOs from slo-toolkit (cached) and attaches a concise snapshot (objective, burn rate, current error budget).
- Attaches runbook metadata: title, short excerpt (first 3 steps) and a direct link to the runbook storage.
- Appends last 24h on-call notes (if present) pulled from oncall-notes service to provide human context.
- Introduces rate limiting and size caps to avoid noisy/large messages in pagers.

Implementation notes:
- New connector module incident_bot/connectors/slo_snapshot.py that wraps existing slo-toolkit helpers and exposes a small serializable snapshot.
- Runbook lookups reuse the runbook index in observability-pack; only metadata is included, full runbook is linked, not inlined.
- On-call notes ingestion calls the oncall-notes internal API with a 250ms timeout and falls back to 'no recent notes' on error.
- Feature gated via incident-bot config (incident_bot.config.escalation_context.enabled) and per-service override.

Testing and rollout:
- Unit tests added for snapshot formatting and size truncation.
- E2E integration tests added in perf-canary with a mocked slo-toolkit backend.
- Staged rollout: default disabled; enable for a small set of SRE-managed services first.

Checklist:
- [x] Connector module and helpers implemented
- [x] Unit tests added and passing
- [x] Integration test harness updated
- [x] Feature flag and config documented
- [x] Rollout plan included

Related: ENG-4821 (slo snapshot API), ENG-4823 (runbook index improvements).
